# Lab 19.8: Data Lineage

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a small chain of tables, then view table-level and column-level lineage and use it for impact analysis.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Build a chain.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab19.stg_orders AS
SELECT order_id, user_id, LOWER(status) AS status, created_at FROM lab19.orders;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab19.orders_by_country AS
SELECT u.country, o.status, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM lab19.stg_orders o JOIN lab19.users u ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY 1, 2;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Open the lineage graph.** Open `lab19.orders_by_country → Lineage`. You see `orders` and `users` → `stg_orders` → `orders_by_country`. Click a link to see the job that created it.

3. **[Console] Column-level lineage.** Switch to **Column lineage** and click `country`. It traces back to `users.country`. Click `status` and it traces to `orders.status` through `LOWER()`.

4. **[Console] Impact analysis.** Open `lab19.orders → Lineage` and look **downstream**. Before changing or deleting `orders`, you can see every table that depends on it. Use **highlight/filter** to focus on one path.

5. **[CLI] Read lineage with the API.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">TOKEN=$(gcloud auth print-access-token)
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://datalineage.googleapis.com/v1/projects/$PROJECT_ID/locations/us:searchLinks" \
  -d "{\"source\": {\"fullyQualifiedName\": \"bigquery:$PROJECT_ID.lab19.orders\"}}"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Table lineage | Built automatically from jobs |
| Column lineage | Traces each output column |
| Impact analysis | Downstream view before changes |
| API | `searchLinks` |
